name: @oge-ui/layout
description: Signal-based Angular layout family: OgeAccordion with declarative <oge-accordion-item> children or data-driven items, APG keyboard support, single/multiple expansion, lazy rendering, async expand guards, invalid-section indicators and per-panel async content loaders; OgeSplitter with resizable, collapsible and nestable panes following the WAI-ARIA window splitter pattern; OgeToolbar with a WAI-ARIA APG roving tabindex, before/center/after groups and an overflow menu for the commands that stop fitting; OgeCard, a content surface with header, full-bleed media, action row and footer as attribute slots, outlined/raised/filled/flat chrome and a horizontal orientation; and the loading trio OgeProgressBar/OgeLoadIndicator/OgeSkeleton with the aria progressbar contract done right.
author: kaya2m
